title: 第161章 是兄弟就来砍我第160章 双向奔赴
slug: 娇娇挺孕肚死遁清冷师尊黑化了
content_zh:
姜珊双臂尽断，本命剑的下场跟裴昭的本命剑下场一样。
而镜头终于转动了一下，看向造成这一切的凶手。
姜寂。
此时的姜寂刚把裴昭的头颅送到清风镇，在此之前，林帜已经假借姜家之名给姜珊发了消息。
让他在这里等着，果然等到了姜珊。
姜珊虽然已经没有了反抗的能力，也预感了到了自己会死的结局，她并不怎么害怕，但为了泄愤还是一直骂着姜寂。
但傀儡姜寂根本听不懂，他按照林帜的命令虐杀了姜珊，把她的尸体钉在树干上，然后走了。
出发之前，林帜是这么对他说的：“宁楚夺走了我们的爱人，我们也要一个个除掉她的爱人，让她生不如死！”
傀儡姜寂：我叮（口音）不懂啦，你让我干啥就干啥呗。
画面最后定格在姜珊了无生机的身体上，血液一滴一滴落在草地。
她还没有断气，但已经进气多出气少，她艰难地转动着自己的头，流着血泪的眼睛看向天剑宗的方向。
那是她的家。
留影石到此陷入黑暗。
“啊啊啊啊！”宝儿直接破防，“姜寂，林帜！我要杀了他们！”
为什么，为什么要这么对姜珊。
技不如人，姜珊输了，她可以认，但没必要这么折磨她吧！
看完两个留影石里的画面，天剑宗上下都愤怒不已。
“师尊，我们现在就出发海华城，替师姐师弟报仇！请您下令。”
众人齐声：“请您下令！”
“……”

此战，可以死，但不会退。
若是不帮姜珊裴昭报这个仇，他们有何颜面活在这世上。
天剑宗有何颜面立于浮生界！
看见二师姐的死法，想着先忍一忍以待来日的裴昭都红了眼睛，浑身戾气迸发。
杀杀杀，全杀了。
秦玖见状一惊，忙用灵珠收了他，捏在手里晃了晃，“裴昭，冷静点。”
他可不能被戾气和怨气控制。
伯言看完两块留影石里的内容，听见震撼人心求战的话，感觉自己都快被愤怒和憎恨点燃。
但他勉强还留有最后一丝理智，忙站出来说：“不行啊，阁主说了会败，不能去！”
他看着周围的人，苦口婆心地劝道：“冷静，冷静点，我知道你们很愤怒，但是……”
伯言想劝他们，但是话说到这里，突然不知道该说些什么才好。
作为外人，有些话当然可以随便说，反正不关他的事。
可在看了裴昭跟姜珊被杀现场后，他又发现那些安慰都太过于轻飘飘，实则一点用都没有。
天剑宗众弟子，包括宝儿跟顾玄在内等人皆群情激奋，到底还是宁雄霸和厚朴等人稍微冷静些。
他们现在也很想直接冲到海华城去杀了林帜，但他们不止一个人，在他们身后还有数千天剑宗弟子。
为替弟子报仇，他们可以死，但他们不想看着这些弟子去送死。
宁楚则是敛眉沉思，她们这次去海华城，真的会输吗？
哪怕有师尊在，有自己的外挂在，也会输？
content_en:
Jiang Shan's arms were broken, and the fate of the natal sword was the same as that of Pei Zhao's natal sword.
And the camera finally turned and looked at the murderer who caused all this.
Jiang Ji.
At this time, Jiang Jigang had just sent Pei Zhao's head to Qingfeng Town. Before that, Lin Zhi had already sent a message to Jiang Shan under the guise of the Jiang family.
Ask him to wait here, and as expected, Jiang Shan is waiting.
Although Jiang Shan no longer had the ability to resist and had a premonition that she would die, she was not very afraid, but she still kept scolding Jiang Ji in order to vent her anger.
But the puppet Jiang Ji didn't understand at all. He followed Lin Zhi's order and killed Jiang Shan, nailed her body to the tree trunk, and then left.
Before setting off, Lin Zhi said to him: "Ning Chu has taken away our lover, so we must get rid of her lovers one by one and make her life worse than death!"
Puppet Jiang Ji: I don’t understand (accent), just do whatever you ask me to do.
The scene finally freezes on Jiang Shan's lifeless body, with blood falling drop by drop on the grass.
She had not yet expired, but she had taken in more air than out breath. She turned her head with difficulty and looked in the direction of Tianjian Sect with tears in her eyes.
That's her home.
The Image Stone has now fallen into darkness.
"Ahhhh!" Bao'er broke through the defense directly, "Jiang Ji, Lin Zhi! I'm going to kill them!"
Why, why do you do this to Jiang Shan.
She was inferior in skill and Jiang Shan lost. She could admit it, but there was no need to torture her like this!
After seeing the scenes in the two recording stones, everyone in the Tianjian Sect was furious.
"Master, we are leaving Haihua City now to avenge our senior sister and brother! Please give your order."
Everyone shouted in unison: "Please give the order!"
"..."
In this battle, you can die, but you won't retreat.
If they don't help Jiang Shan and Pei Zhao take revenge, how can they live in this world?
How can Tianjian Sect have the dignity to stand in the world of floating life!
Seeing the way Second Senior Sister died, Pei Zhao, who wanted to endure it for a while and wait for the future, had his eyes red and rage burst out all over his body.
Kill, kill, kill them all.
Qin Jiu was shocked when he saw this, and quickly used the spirit bead to collect him, holding it in his hand and shaking it, "Pei Zhao, calm down."
He cannot be controlled by anger and resentment.
After Boyan read the contents of the two image stones and heard the shocking words of petition for war, he felt like he was about to be ignited by anger and hatred.
But he still managed to retain the last trace of reason, so he stood up and said: "No, the master of the pavilion said he would lose, so he can't go!"
He looked at the people around him and advised earnestly: "Calm down, calm down, I know you are angry, but..."
Boyan wanted to persuade them, but at this point, he suddenly didn't know what to say.
As an outsider, of course he can say some things casually, it is none of his business anyway.
But after seeing the scene where Pei Zhao and Jiang Shan were killed, he found that those comforts were too light and in fact useless.
The disciples of Tianjian Sect, including Bao'er and Gu Xuan, were all excited. In the end, Ning Xiongba, Houpu and others were a little calmer.
They also wanted to rush directly to Haihua City to kill Lin Zhi, but they were not alone, and there were thousands of Tianjian Sect disciples behind them.
They could die to avenge their disciples, but they didn't want to watch these disciples die.
Ning Chu frowned and thought deeply. Will they really lose when they go to Haihua City this time?
Even if the master is here and his own cheat is here, he will still lose?
